title: 目標達成の後に・みんなのちゃんこ鍋☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A new post on Umasta reads, "Announcing the Chanko Tournament! Show off your best chanko to everybody! ☆ Apply now!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aaand posted!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I sure hope everybody has fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a fine day, and I find myself at the Chanko Tournament, an event Hishi Akebono set up for her fans.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect so many people to come! Thank you so much, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Just a reminder of the rules I posted on Umasta—every one of you will have to make your own chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Do you have your recipes ready?

text_block_list.name: Bono Fans
text_block_list.text: We sure do!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Great! Looks like your preparations are perfect. ☆ Let's have fun, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to get cooking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's interesting how you have different ways to make broth.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yes, I prefer to slowly simmer kombu seaweed, bonito flakes, and various dried seafoods together to bring out their flavor.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: I prefer to save time by using a blend of store-bought soup base and chicken broth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I see! Both have a very buono aroma!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wow! I see you're making a spicy chanko with gochujang paste and kimchi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, and you're using miso! It smells so nice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Watching everyone has inspired me so much! Trainer, let's try to make the best chanko ever!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I watched Bono's latest stream, and well… You're Bono's trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: I was really happy when we got to see a new side of Bono as a racer!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: I became quite interested in races after that, and I really want to see her race in person!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: Me too! After that stream, I realized races were more exciting than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Hishi Akebono's strategy of filling up the stands by filling up the audience's stomachs first is working great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone seems to be enjoying chanko tournament until…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh? That aroma…

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what do you think you're doing, adding in pork and curry roux? This isn't a curry competition, you know.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan D
text_block_list.text: But my kids love it when I make this chanko for them. They say they like this version the best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small argument breaks out near the edge of the venue.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: You're giving your children this and calling it chanko? Let me set things straight for you.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: My father is a chef and he says real chanko is made with chicken meatballs and vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan D
text_block_list.text: B-but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks start flying, but Hishi Akebono puts an end to it by making a casual remark.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's true that chanko made with chicken meatballs and veggies is yummy and buono.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: Oh! Bono…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But the neat thing about chanko is that each sumo stable has its own unique recipe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There are salty variations and spicy ones. Some wrestlers even add cheese and yogurt into their chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Each stable creates their own chanko by making different adjustments to the recipe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's those differences that make their flavors so special and memorable.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I think it's okay not to use chicken meatballs or veggies in your chanko if you don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: As long as your chanko makes the people who eat it happy and ready to keep working hard, then it's real chanko!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I was being too narrow-minded…

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan D
text_block_list.text: I got caught up in the moment too, so I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan C
text_block_list.text: No, it was all me… And I'm sorry I ruined your event, Bono…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You don't have to apologize! There's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But enough of that. The broth of your chanko looks so clear and tasty!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You must've put a lot of effort into getting the basics exactly right while making this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The meat in your curry chanko looks super yummy too! ♪ I think tons of people will love this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone made so many types of chanko. There are spicy ones and creamy ones…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They might be different, but they all look so buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to try each one with you all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's easygoing energy clears the air, and the Chanko Tournament ends on a warm note.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her bond with her fans has grown even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for the great time at the Chanko Tournament, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "All of your chankos were very buono!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let's all protect and preserve our own unique flavors! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aaand posted!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… That was so much fun, and there was so much great chanko.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Best of all, a whole lot more people are interested in racing now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters S. will be held right after summer camp ends. Now's the time to ramp up our training so we can be at our best for it!
